title: A time-series network approach to auditory verbal hallucinations: Examining dynamic interactions using experience sampling methodology
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-persons network
limitations: - Factors like contextual variables, meta-cognitive beliefs, and symptom appraisals were not included; - Variables with different measurement levels could not be analysed; - Violation of fixed time interval assumption; - Group-level analysis may not capture individual-specific dynamics; - Centrality measures are point estimates and may not be reliably estimated; - Small sample size may limit generalizability.
notes: The paper does not explicitly mention preregistration. Code and data are declared available in the Online Supplementary Materials, but verification of availability is required. The study used a convenience sample, which may limit generalizability.
